metadata.accuracy_policy: User accepted as authoritative for this personal map; source-level precision caveats remain explicit per feature.
metadata.classification_note: strict_old_growth=false means context retained from the same research collection, not a confirmed old-growth stand/tree.

properties.name: SubAlp Whitebark
properties.species: Whitebark pine (Pinus albicaulis); lodgepole pine; subalpine fir
properties.access: Hwy 75 ~23 mi N of Ketchum; pull-outs at summit and Galena Overlook.
properties.summary: Drive-to krummholz whitebark pine at Galena Summit; accessible old subalpine habitat.

properties.name: Cottonwood Corridor!
properties.access: Wood River Trail through Ketchum; River Run area; year-round.
properties.summary: Mature black-cottonwood corridor through Ketchum; culturally associated with Hemingway.

properties.name: Redfish Lake Creek / Salmon River Riparian Corridor
properties.access: FR 214 south from Stanley ~4 mi; Stanley–Redfish multi-use trail follows corridor.
properties.summary: Intact SNRA riparian corridor with salmon, steelhead, bull trout, and rare-sedge habitat.

properties.name: Ancient Limber Pines
properties.age: 1,500–2,000 yr (USFS/IDFG records cited in user research)
properties.access: Visible from Trail Creek Rd near the pass; no defined trailhead for specific trees.
properties.summary: Government documents cited in the research report limber pines east of the RNA aged at 1,500–2,000 years.

properties.name: SNRA HQ / North Fork Big Wood Forest
properties.access: Hwy 75 ~8 mi N of Ketchum; SNRA HQ / North Fork Rd.
properties.summary: Gateway forest to the SNRA with mature/old conifer stands.

properties.name: Limber & Whitebark
properties.species: Limber pine (Pinus flexilis); whitebark pine (Pinus albicaulis)
properties.age: Ancient, large-diameter; no single age cited
properties.access: Trail Creek Rd, FR 140, ford Trail Creek, then FS Trail 124 up Cold Canyon.
properties.summary: Basin Gulch Research Natural Area: intact limber/whitebark old-growth and avalanche-maintained pygmy forest.

properties.name: Sawtooth Valley Peatlands RNA (Fens)
properties.species: Willow; sedge; bog birch; lodgepole pine on margins
properties.access: West of Hwy 75 along moraine bases; no formal trailheads; sensitive habitat.
properties.summary: 273-acre fen complex with rare boreal plants and salmon habitat; retained as ecological context, not old growth.

properties.name: Harriman Trail Forest Corridor (Baker/Prairie Creek)
properties.access: Multiple access points off Hwy 75; non-motorized.
properties.summary: 18-mile Big Wood River corridor offering an accessible cross-section of mature valley forest.

properties.name: Trail Creek Pass Summit
properties.species: Whitebark pine; limber pine; subalpine fir (krummholz)
properties.age: Several centuries plausible; no published measurement cited
properties.access: Trail Creek Rd ~12 mi NE of Ketchum; paved then gravel; seasonal closure.
properties.summary: Drive-to 7,896-ft pass with krummholz five-needle pines in the same old-growth zone as Basin Gulch.

properties.name: Cultural, not old-growth.
properties.access: Trail Creek Rd ~1 mi east of Sun Valley Lodge; year-round.
properties.summary: Hemingway memorial and mature riparian cottonwoods; intentionally retained as cultural context, not old growth.

properties.name: Whitebark Pine  |idaho champion|
properties.age: >1,270-year old individual documented in this landscape; Idaho champion by size noted at Imogene Lake
properties.access: Imogene Lake access via Hell Roaring Lake Rd (FR 097); long subalpine hike.
properties.summary: Research notes the world’s oldest documented whitebark pine in this landscape and Idaho champion by size at Imogene Lake.

properties.name: Giant Cedar Grove
properties.access: ~10 mi N of Elk River via CR 382 and FS Rd 4764; Giant Red Cedar NRT #748.
properties.summary: Trailhead for an accessible loop through old-growth western red cedar.

properties.name: Redfish Lake Moraine RNA
properties.access: Hwy 75 to FR 214; Redfish Ridge Trail traverses the RNA.
properties.summary: 1,470-acre glacial lateral-moraine forest; late-successional and noted as undisturbed since 1996.

properties.name: Schulman Limber Pine
properties.species: Limber pine (Pinus flexilis), historical individual now dead
properties.access: Location intentionally imprecise; slopes above Ketchum/Sun Valley, likely Trail Creek corridor.
properties.summary: Schulman’s 1,659-year limber pine helped inspire his bristlecone work; tree felled in 1953 and exact location is unmapped.

properties.name: CHAMPION CEDAR
properties.access: Short marked footpath beyond Giant Cedar Grove trailhead.
properties.summary: “Champion Tree of Idaho” western red cedar, noted at 18+ ft diameter; coordinate approximate ±0.25 mi.
